Validation: the existing business-input CI entry point passed 57 checks; the exact-pair regression including 27 negative checks passed. Primary semantic capability verification and independent capability verification both pass against main 24fae4bfd7c2383ee5719bb9aeade71bb17a43ec. Rollback: revert this change.

The workflow permission/token/path changes in the initial Draft were removed after the normal Dispatcher rejected their capability delta. The missing read-only artifact access remains unresolved; no workflow permissions or protected gates are changed by this revision.

Scope: reversible internal connection hardening for AUTONOMOUS_NORMAL_OPERATIONS_CLOSURE_MISSION. No producer is registered, provider data acquired, remote storage authorized, or domain certified. Lawful current transaction/liquidity input and native domain producers remain missing. Production/Public/G5/provider activation remain HOLD.
